description: Publish a NEW VERSION of an agent's job contract (append-only: the previous active version for the same workload is superseded in the same transaction). Required: workload, objective, unit_of_work, acceptance_criteria (1-20), kpi_target, budget (dollars per daily|weekly|monthly period, stored as micro-dollars), owner. Optional: human_baseline (what a person costs per unit, in dollars), and the vendor terms vendor_name, billable_unit and vendor_resolved_definition (the vendor's own wording, kept verbatim, not verified); on a new version an omitted optional keeps the current value and null clears it. Workload-policy terms are inherited from the current version unless supplied in policy_terms. For an agent with no version yet, set policy_defaults: 'inherit_workload_policy' copies the org's workload-level policy (a snapshot), 'observe_only' gets terms that grant no authority (needs task_verb and domain in policy_terms); otherwise every term must be in policy_terms. The contract is RECORDED, not enforced at runtime: nothing blocks spend or traffic on it. Needs an API key with the 'admin' scope — an org owner or admin mints one in Settings → Security → API Keys; any other key is refused with 403. Do NOT use to read a contract — use get_job_contract. Requires an API key with the 'admin' scope.

acceptance_criteria.description: What "done well" means: 1-20 {metric, op, threshold, window}

metric.description: Metric name in your vocabulary (e.g. field_accuracy)

threshold.description: Threshold the metric is compared against

agent_key.description: The agent_key (the X-Agent-ID string), not the UUID

billable_unit.description: What the vendor bills per, in the vendor's words (e.g. 'resolution'). null clears it.

budget_dollars.description: Declared spend limit in dollars per period (recorded, not enforced)

basis.description: How the figure was arrived at (e.g. time sheets, a quote)

cost_per_unit_usd.description: What one unit costs when a person does it, in dollars

minutes_per_unit.description: A person's minutes per unit, when known

human_baseline.description: Optional, owner-stated, never measured. Omit to keep the current version’s; null clears it.

kpi_target.description: The number the agent is held to over a rolling window

notes.description: Optional note recorded on this version

objective.description: What this agent is for, in your words

owner.description: User id or email accountable for this agent

policy_defaults.description: First version only: where engine terms come from. 'inherit_workload_policy' copies the org's active workload-level policy (refused when none exists); 'observe_only' grants no authority (every action class shadow). Ignored when the agent already has a version.

policy_terms.description: Optional workload-policy terms (unit, eligible_traffic, primary_quality, critical_guardrails, signal, non_inferiority, cost_definition, permitted_actions, exposure_budget, rollback_fast, rollback_slow, evidence_expiry, task_verb, domain). Omit to inherit from the current version.

vendor_name.description: Who you pay for this agent’s work (the AI vendor). null clears it.

vendor_resolved_definition.description: The vendor's own definition of "resolved", word for word. Stored unchanged and shown as the vendor's definition, not verified. null clears it.

name: metrx_set_job_contract
title: Set Job Contract
